title: Scene Candidates
description: The scene scout's menu: passages of the book that would make good short videos, each anchored to verbatim quotes so the user can pick one. Produced after book_ingest, before any money is spent.

book_summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what the book is, in the book's language

title.description: Short name of the scene, book's language

start_quote.description: Verbatim first words of the passage

end_quote.description: Verbatim last words of the passage

summary.description: One or two sentences, book's language

why.description: Why it works on screen: action, emotion, a turn, a strong image

characters.description: Names as written in the book

character_age_notes.description: e.g. 'Abi as a child (~9)' - drives which identity variant is needed

needs_references.description: Characters with no picture yet: real people need a photo from the user

readable_text.description: Verbatim text that must be READABLE on screen (letters, diaries, signs) - rendered as overlays, never by the video model

visual_score.description: How well it can be shown (not told): 5 = clear action and setting

risk_notes.description: Violence, many characters, crowds, heavy dialogue, abstract ideas

selected.description: Candidate ids the user picked, in production order
